snippet.title: Risk of Rain 2: Alloyed Collective | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Alloyed Collective Steam Store Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2781620/
Steam News Post (with patch notes):
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/632360/view/534364965583192572
Lured, enslaved, and left to rust. The Alloyed Collective now stirs from the scrap of their fallen allies, driven by a singular purpose: returning home. Master one all-new and one veteran Survivor to fight through 7 new Stages. Perfect your build by collecting 18 new Items. Bolster your strength with 7 new Drones and descend deep into Petrichor V to take on the Alloyed Collective’s ultimate creation, Solus Wing.

💬 Join the community: https://discord.gg/riskofrain2

#RiskOfRain2 #AlloyedCollective #Trailer
